title: Surface encoder descriptor selection on attempt plans
summary: Surface descriptor-selection evidence on pure encode attempt plans while preserving existing FFmpeg argument snapshots and leaving dormant encoders inactive.
reason: Encoder breadth activation needs attempt-plan evidence showing when descriptor selection is actually active for current HEVC/libx265 parity paths and when resolved dormant selections are still legacy/inactive before Do-Encode can safely consume broader descriptor choices.
behavior_before: Encode attempt plans exposed selected encoder, encoder kind, GPU device, flags, and arguments, but did not carry descriptor-selection evidence tying the plan to the descriptor resolver or distinguishing active HEVC parity from dormant resolved selections.
behavior_after: Encode attempt plans include DescriptorSelection evidence with resolution state, family, selected encoder, primary/fallback descriptor names, trace entries, and an Active flag. Current HEVC/NVENC and libx265 parity plans are marked active; dormant AV1 selection resolves as evidence but remains explicitly inactive because descriptor flag activation is still disabled. FFmpeg arguments, retry decisions, and Do-Encode ladder behavior are unchanged.
